title: Improved quote form submission and error reporting
summary: Added the selected service type to the CRM request URL and made submission failures show whether the server or connection failed.
impact: Helps quote requests reach the CRM and gives the team a clearer starting point when a customer reports an error.

title: Improve quote submissions in Instagram browser
summary: Changed the shared quote form and Marketplace form to send JSON as a simple cross-origin request, avoiding the browser preflight step. The production CRM endpoint was verified to parse this format.
impact: Reduces submission failures for visitors opening the site inside Instagram and other in-app browsers.

title: Keep quote requests available until confirmed
summary: Quote forms now save an unconfirmed request for retry, reuse its submission ID to prevent duplicate leads, and try a standard browser form POST when fetch fails. The saved request is cleared only after server confirmation.
impact: Reduces lost requests from Instagram and other in-app browsers while giving visitors a clear retry path.

title: Improved homepage hero and quote form spacing
summary: Removed the fixed hero height and cramped short-screen form rules, and added consistent spacing around the hero content and form fields.
impact: Makes the homepage quote form easier to scan and use on desktop and mobile screens.

title: Fit the homepage quote form into the first screen
summary: Rearranged quote fields into fewer desktop rows, reduced excess hero spacing, and changed the SMS checkbox to an opt-out preference.
impact: Keeps the quote button visible on typical laptop screens and records whether a visitor opts out of SMS updates.
